name: Cyborg Jungle
bio:
I love exploring the boundaries of analog video: breaking it, and by breaking it, creating a beautiful, unique, weird and crunchy analog glitch aesthetic that reminds me of a fictional cyberpunk future.

Every piece starts as video. I feed it through a chain of analog video mixers and effect modules onto a CRT monitor, then film the screen with my phone. The stills on this site are frames from that footage, so the whole workflow stays analog.
